title: System menu Realtime Security module
summary: Added an admin-only Realtime Security page under System with auth-log telemetry, configurable realtime-security controls, and a malware-check action (UI button + API) that returns a scan report.

items: Builds last-24h auth telemetry and risk level from logs/auth.log
Added malwareCheck() web action and apiMalwareCheck() endpoint
Added PHP malware scanner for App/, Core/, public/, and cli/ paths with suspicious-pattern findings report
Added apiSummary() payload used by /api/system/realtime-security including last_malware_scan
New Run Malware Check button, scan result summary, and findings table on Realtime Security page
Existing metric cards, protection settings form, and recent auth events table retained
Latest auth events region updated with AJAX-friendly DOM targets for live refresh
Updates risk/attempt/failure/blocked metric cards and latest auth events table without page reload

Added routes: GET /system/realtime-security, POST /system/realtime-security/update, POST /system/realtime-security/malware-check, GET /api/system/realtime-security, POST /api/system/realtime-security/malware-check
Added System menu entry and active-state support for realtime-security in top and sidebar layouts
Added realtimeSecurity() API handler wiring to realtime security summary
Added realtimeSecurityMalwareCheck() API handler wiring to malware-check action
Mapped realtime-security page key to view_security_settings for menu-capability lookup consistency
Throttle runtime now applies realtime_security_failed_login_threshold when Realtime Security and Auto-block suspicious IPs are enabled
IP block trigger now logs threshold and lockout metadata to auth.log
Documented new realtime security module, endpoints, and integration contract
